name: Investigate the dispute with Advisor Ghrim

evidence.note: Throne of Miscellania unlocks the follow-up quest. Agility and Slayer 40 are later skill gates, not required to start.

name: Speak to your royal partner astrid

evidence.note: The Throne of Miscellania partner selection carries over; only the chosen royal is eligible.

name: Speak to your royal partner brand

evidence.note: The Throne of Miscellania partner selection carries over; only the chosen royal is eligible.

name: Investigate the stolen supplies with King Vargas

evidence.note: Royal family conversation follows whichever partner was courted.

name: Question Gardener Gunnhild about the kingdom

evidence.note: Quest Helper interaction outside Miscellania castle.

name: Question Queen Sigrid about the thefts

evidence.note: Etceteria royal diplomacy.

name: Interview Matilda at Etceteria castle

evidence.note: Speak to Matilda before returning to Sigrid.

name: Report Matilda's information to Sigrid

evidence.note: Unlocks the dungeon evidence sequence.

name: Obtain permission from Vargas to investigate the caves

evidence.note: Return to Vargas for the first order.

name: Ask Ghrim about the missing sailor

evidence.note: Ghrim directs the player to the docks.

name: Find the missing sailor's lead at Miscellania docks

evidence.note: Sailor directs the regent back to Vargas.

name: Claim the regent's dungeon authorisation

evidence.note: Vargas grants a scroll proving royal authority to enter the dungeon.

name: Buy coal and combat food for Royal Trouble

evidence.note: Approximate GE budget for five coal and twelve lobsters; actual food spending varies, and coal can alternatively be mined in the quest dungeon.

name: Enter the Miscellania cave and question Donal

evidence.note: Use the courtyard ladder, show the regent scroll and talk to Donal.

name: Prop open the mining crevice

evidence.note: Obtain the support prop from the cave area and enter the narrow mine passage.

name: Fuel the engine and build the pulley lift

evidence.note: Collect nearby beams, three pulleys and ropes from crates. Coal fuels engine; remaining rope and plank are carried through the obstacle route.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Engine is fuelled and the scaffold lift works with the correct beam-pulley configuration.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Recollect loose parts from crates and complete the remaining pulleys and beams before using the lift.

name: Cross slippery rocks and recover evidence

evidence.note: Use rope and plank; recover diary and scattered pages from campfires. Quest Helper marks 40 Agility boostable, not a quest-start gate.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All diary pages are collected and the player reaches the sea-snake passage.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Return to the most recent fire and cross obstacles again with food or agility boost available.

name: Defeat the Giant Sea Snake (level 149)

evidence.note: Instanced boss encounter; 8-lobster allowance is a budget, and poison, combat XP and damage are not deterministically modeled.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Giant Sea Snake is defeated, and the heavy Etceterian supplies box is picked up.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Prepare more food, protection and antipoison, then return through the caves to repeat the boss attempt.

name: Deliver the evidence to Sigrid and collect her payment

evidence.note: Queen Sigrid pays 20,000 coins and supplies a letter after the Giant Sea Snake proof; money is not paid again at Vargas.

name: Conclude peace with King Vargas

evidence.note: The three fixed 5,000 XP awards and quest point occur on completion; Sigrid already granted the 20,000 coins. Bosun Zarah is only hireable at 80 Sailing.

name: Listen to Larry's penguin concerns at Ardougne Zoo

evidence.note: Five pinned base-level skill requirements gate the quest. Some secondary guides differ on Crafting boosts; use unboosted pinned helper requirement.

name: Buy the clockwork and penguin infiltration materials

evidence.note: Estimated trade-enabled bundle for the construction hide, clockwork suit, raw cod meeting and bongos. The fee is a planning budget rather than a current price quote.

name: Construct and conceal the snowy penguin observation hide

evidence.note: Larry brings you to the Iceberg. Use ten unnoted oak planks and ten nails, then cover the hide with snow.

name: Watch penguins and memorise their greeting emotes

evidence.note: The three greeting emotes are learned in the observation cutscene and reused at later penguin contacts.

name: Find a crafting table 3 or better

evidence.note: Clockmaker table 3 access is required: use own POH table or an assisting player's house. This conditional access is not inferred from Construction 34 alone.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Player can operate a functioning crafting table 3 or higher in a player-owned house.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Build the table with separate materials, or visit a friend who provides the required clockmaker bench.

name: Craft the clockwork penguin disguise at the crafting table

evidence.note: Make clockwork from steel bar, then the penguin toy with normal plank and silk. Timings and incidental crafting XP require review.

name: Demonstrate the penguin disguise to Larry on the Iceberg

evidence.note: Larry transports the player for further undercover contact.

name: Infiltrate the zoo's penguin enclosure

evidence.note: Use the bird-hide greeting emotes and return to Larry with the zoo mission report.

name: Talk to the disguised penguins near Fred's farm

evidence.note: Larry's Lumbridge undercover task requires the penguin suit and greeting emotes.

name: Convince the zoo penguins using raw cod

evidence.note: Chosen raw-cod alternative to wearing Ring of Charos(a), which is not consumed. If cod is not accepted, check mission-report dialogue.

name: Take a cowbell from a Lumbridge dairy cow

evidence.note: Steal cowbell for use as a penguin musical instrument. No uncertain incidental XP is modeled.

name: Reassure Fred and report to the undercover sheep

evidence.note: Resolve Fred dialogue and revisit Larry to return to the Iceberg.

name: Use the greeting and mission reports to gain a KGP ID

evidence.note: Meet the KGP Agent and Noodle on the Iceberg. Swamp tar and regular feathers are held for the mission; precise consumption needs independent review.

name: Pass the avalanche checkpoint into the penguin base

evidence.note: Use the identity card and interact with outpost guards.

name: Cross the Iceberg penguin agility course

evidence.note: Swim through moving ice, jump stones and traverse icicles. Exact damage and training XP depend on failures; record conditional success.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Reach the agility instructor, finish the course, and speak with Larry about the penguin army.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Retry the failed obstacle, use food, or return to Larry after leaving the penguin suit.

name: Learn why Ping and Pong cannot play

evidence.note: The penguin musicians need a replacement instrument for the control-room diversion.

name: Make penguin bongos using mahogany plank and leather

evidence.note: Craft bongos outside the disguise; cowbell is retained to accompany the performance.

name: Distract the outpost and enter its war room

evidence.note: Return to Ping and Pong, operate the panel and uncover the secret Iceberg war room.

name: Defeat an Icelord to escape the war room

evidence.note: At least one Icelord must die and awards 40 fixed Attack XP; additional kills up to three and incidental combat XP remain variable.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the guarding Icelord(s) and pass the western escape door.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Re-enter with a suitable combat loadout and food; update count of icelords actually defeated.

name: Escape and report the penguin plot to Larry

evidence.note: Leave through the chasm and report to Larry. Completion gives 1 QP and fixed 2,000 Crafting, 5,000 Agility, 1,500 Construction XP. The earlier 40 Attack XP is from an Icelord.
